rv.q: Brigham's flat, static direction sits characters on barrels or crates for each scene... there's no rising temperature or undercurrent of cooped-up, coiled tension.
Overall, this feels like an uneven production that often seems long, slow and ponderous.
The whole cast were simply sublime, especially seeing as they all had to adapt to a cast illness and cast reshuffle.
This production utilises a fantastic cast and a careful approach to make Of Mice and Men a performance that is not to be missed.

Crooks is played by Jeff Alexander who, like the character, has sustained a major back injury. Candy is played by Benjamin Wilson, and both the actor and the original character have different disabilities: Candy in the original novella has a limb difference, and Wilson is a visually impaired actor.
